title: Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Biz Dev)
description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios (Biz Dev) em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Você terá a oportunidade de estruturar um canal de receita do zero, com liberdade e autonomia, atuando de forma empreendedora. Sua atuação terá visibilidade para a alta liderança da companhia e irá se reportar diretamente para o CRO da Conta Azul. Terá impacto direto no crescimento da companhia com resultados ainda em 2025, podendo se tornar um importante canal de receita, com oportunidades claras de crescimento de carreira e potencial liderança com estruturação de um time especializado. Será necessário aprendizado e entendimento profundo de modelos de franquia e licenciamento, pois esse será o seu principal nicho de atuação inicialmente. Você será responsável por desenvolver negócios e fazer as primeiras vendas para grupos econômicos que tem a necessidade de apurar o resultado financeiro consolidado e que atuam com rede de franqueados / licenciados (PMEs). Portanto, você irá efetuar uma venda consultiva com múltiplos stakeholders (CFO, franqueador/licenciador, unidades franqueadas ou licenciadas). Este é um nicho ainda não explorado pela Conta Azul, apesar de já termos validado essa oportunidade de mercado. A Conta Azul é movida pela crença que todo empreendedor merece ter sucesso. Apesar do dia a dia cheio de responsabilidades, queremos que todo dono de um pequeno negócio consiga tempo para se dedicar ao que sempre sonhou quando decidiu abrir uma empresa. Por isso, usamos a tecnologia para criar uma plataforma em nuvem, onde o empreendedor juntamente com o seu contador, de forma simples e fácil, podem encontrar tudo o que precisam em tempo real. Buscamos pessoas motivadas neste propósito. Se você é esta pessoa, junte-se a nós! Responsabilidades e atribuições  Construir e validar o perfil ideal de cliente (ICP). Realizar prospecção outbound (CFOs, Controllers, Diretores) - Inside Sales e Field Sales. Conduzir reuniões diagnósticas e orquestrar POCs com suporte do time de produto e tech. Trabalhar com áreas de RevOps e Pricing para montar propostas comerciais. Alimentar CRM com dados estruturados e gerar insights de canal e reportar semanalmente aprendizados, gargalos e potenciais para escala. Estabelecer relações comerciais duradouras com foco em geração de valor mútuo.  Requisitos e qualificações  Capacidade de gerar interesse e marcar reuniões com decisores a partir do zero. Habilidade para mapear segmentos, qualificar leads e interpretar padrões de comportamento. Utiliza dados de forma inteligente e sistemática. Faz leitura de dados para construir soluções e tomar as decisões. Acompanha métricas e entende seus reflexos nas estratégias, planos e resultados. Utiliza-se de analises para traduzir contextos. Capacidade de compreender o mercado em que a Conta Azul está inserida, soluções do ERP e as dores dos principais segmentos. Entendimento básico das estruturas operacionais e jurídicas de modelos de franquias e licenciamento. Fluência no uso de ferramentas para gerir pipeline e registrar interações com leads. Capacidade de comunicar ideias com clareza, escutar ativamente e construir relações de confiança com diferentes stakeholders. Inclui habilidade de conduzir negociações complexas, alinhando interesses diversos e gerando acordos mutuamente vantajosos Capacidade de agir com iniciativa, senso de dono e proatividade. Implica não apenas propor soluções, mas liderar sua implementação com foco em impacto e resultados ganha ganha, mesmo diante de incertezas ou recursos limitados Transitar bem entre áreas internas (produto, jurídico, marketing, vendas, finanças) para que tenha sucesso na implementação das novas negociações e garanta as amarrações das negociações e pontos chave de contato para o novo cliente. Disposição para aprender rapidamente sobre os modelos de negócio dos prospects. Orientação a metas, com aprendizado contínuo e ajustes táticos conforme necessário. Além do olhar de crescimento, ter a responsabilidade pelo impacto gerado, considerando implicações de longo prazo para o negócio, os parceiros e os clientes. Agir como dono das iniciativas e dos resultados. Priorizr crescimento sustentável, não apenas números de curto prazo e assumir erros e corrige rapidamente com aprendizado. Compreensão de indicadores como LTV, CAC, NMRR, e lógica de canais indiretos. Habilidade de se comunicar com fluência em inglês. Preparar materiais, realizar benchmarks internacionais. Comunica-se com objetividade e clareza utilizando o idioma. Tem facilidade para conduzir reuniões, benchmarks e discussões em inglês. Consome materiais em inglês e tem habilidade de produzir documentos e materiais no idioma. Conhecimento em plataformas que aumentam produtividade em cadências de contato. Ter experiência em venda de software para franqueadores e/ou licenciadores. MBA ou especialização em áreas correlatas (negócios, estratégia, inovação, etc.). Experiência comprovada +3 anos com desenvolvimento de negócios, parcerias ou expansão de mercado (Preferencialmente ter vendido software para licenciadores e franquadores)  Informações adicionais:  Plano de saúde com cobertura nacional sem desconto da mensalidade ou coparticipação dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional sem o desconto da mensalidade dos Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Benefício flexível: R$ 1.000,00 para ser investido em educação (reembolso de 70% da mensalidade), idioma (70% da mensalidade) atividades físicas e reembolso referente aos seguintes profissionais: psicólogos(as), nutricionistas, massoterapeutas e fisioterapeutas (50% do custo); Auxílio creche para Papais e Mamães com filhos entre 0 e 24 meses; Auxílio Home Office mensal à partir de R$ 150,00 a depender da localidade; Auxílio Home Office parcela única de R$ 1.500,00 para custear a estação de trabalho; Cartão Flash de vale refeição e alimentação mensal sem desconto; Zenklub: sem limite de sessões no mês para consultas com Psicólogos, Psicanalistas, Terapeutas e Coaches. As duas primeiras sessões do mês são integralmente por nossa conta, e as demais por R$ 20,00 cada; Benefício Farmácia: App Vidalink com subsídio de 75% para medicamentos com receita para todos os Azuis. Pode se estender aos dependentes (filhos, cônjuges, inclusive de pessoas homoafetivas) conforme política interna; Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas.  Pacote de Experiências: Baby Blue Time: jornada menor de trabalho com flexibilidade extra de horário nos retornos das licenças Maternidade e Paternidade dos nossos Azuis; Days Off Experience: Todos os Azuis com mais de 1 ano de casa poderão ter 4 folgas no ano; Sabático Parcialmente Remunerado: período em que os Azuis elegíveis podem ficar off e ainda recebem uma graninha antecipadamente; Seguro de vida: sem desconto; Ambiente inovador que proporciona crescimento, com profissionais incríveis e de aprendizado constante; Escritório com acessibilidade, que estimula a criatividade e produtividade, com comida e bebida à vontade; Horário flexível (trabalhamos de segunda a sexta). title: Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657
description:
Empresa está contratando Sales Engineering Delivery Manager (Middle/Senior) ID39657 em joinville. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Overview  AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.  WHY JOIN US:  If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!  About the Role  As a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager, you will serve as the crucial link between our prospective clients and internal teams. In this role, you will lead technical discovery sessions and consultative introduction calls, gather essential engagement details (such as timelines, budgets, skillset requirements, risks, and SWOT analyses), and translate these insights into impactful proposals. This position requires a strong grasp of both business strategy and the software development lifecycle (SDLC), along with outstanding communication and design skills to create engaging, high-quality deliverables.  Responsibilities   Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement: Assemble Sales Support Engineering team, align them on preliminary information, following internal RACI procedures; Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing interpersonal skills to build rapport and trust quickly; Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception through discovery and development to market release; Use consultative questioning to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements (timeline, budget, skill needs, risk); Present clear, persuasive client-facing communications during calls and emails.  Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation: Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations; Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges uncovered during discovery; Integrate technical insights with business strategy to address immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.  Team Buildout & Project Kickoff: Act as the primary coordination point among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering; ensure smooth handoffs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kickoff; serve as a concierge for deals and translate complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives; maintain a sales/consulting mindset to align proposals with targeted business outcomes.    Qualifications   Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling abilities for clear client-facing communication.  UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.  Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; ability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of business impact.  Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.  Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from funnel to kickoff; ability to serve as a liaison across Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting.  Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and translate them into actionable insights and proposals.  English: Upper Intermediate    Perks & Benefits   Professional growth: mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.  Competitive compensation: USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.  A selection of exciting projects: opportunities with Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.  Flextime: flexible schedule with options for remote work or office presence.    Job Details   Seniority level: Mid-Senior level  Employment type: Full-time  Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting    Notes: This description has been cleaned of extraneous site boilerplate and formatting elements to focus on role responsibilities and requirements.  #J-18808-Ljbffr

Job Description  ✨A little about us  Get to know who we are and what drives our mission.   xChange is the world’s first online B2B marketplace to trade and lease shipping containers. We are a Series B startup with the ambition to become the world’s first and favorite place to buy containers, empowering local traders to seamlessly source and resell boxes while serving as the go-to sales channel for original equipment owners and wholesalers.  Our team of 50+ like-minded xChangees from a great variety of nationalities has made this possible! We have scaled far beyond the small start-up we once were and continue to disrupt the industry together.  🧭 The Role  Your next opportunity—what you'll be doing and how you'll make an impact.   As a Sales Executive at Container xChange, you’ll engage in high-volume B2B container sales into the US market  and help scale our growth rapidly. You’ll manage the full sales cycle , build and own a portfolio of buyers , and play a key role in transforming container trading globally .  This is a highly transactional, full-cycle role  where you will grow your buyer portfolio while closing +300 deals per month . You will work with a qualified lead pool of roughly 15,000 potential buyers and convert both outbound and inbound demand into closed business.  You will run the entire sales cycle : prospecting, outbound calling, qualification, pricing, negotiation, and closing. Once buyers are activated, 70 to 80 percent of your revenue will come from repeat purchases, allowing you to scale your portfolio fast.  Selling into the US market requires strong English skills, speed, commercial judgment , and the ability to operate in a fragmented buyer landscape. Experience working with American customers is highly preferred.     Location  Where you'll be based and how we collaborate globally.   Our headquarters is located in the heart of Hamburg, Germany, with team members distributed across the globe. This is a hybrid position based in São Paulo, Brazil , where you’ll regularly collaborate in person with local colleagues to share ideas and drive customer success while having the flexibility to work from home as well. Since you’ll be targeting the U.S. market, U.S. time zone is required.  🚀 Your Impact  What you'll own, drive, and contribute to our success.   In this role, you will directly shape the future of container trading by helping us build the distribution channel for the entire industry  — giving buyers access to a unified global inventory, transparent price competition, and standardized fulfillment and guarantees. Your work will have a measurable impact on growth, customer experience, and market expansion.    Build and manage a portfolio of US buyers and close high volumes of container deals   Conduct high outbound activity  to find and convert demand, supported by a strong inbound engine  Work with fast sales cycles  and maintain momentum across hundreds of deals  Match customer needs with available inventory and negotiates pricing and margins effectively   Use AI powered sales tool stack  to maximize buyer experience and sales to track leads, monitor sales performance, and gain insights to continuously improve conversion rates      What Makes You a Great Fit?  The experience, skills, and mindset that will help you thrive.   We believe attitude beats years of experience. We’re looking for someone with a winning, competitive mindset  — someone who treats every deal as an opportunity, thrives under high volume , and brings the drive needed to succeed in a fast-paced, transactional sales environment .  You’re a great fit if you:   Have hands-on B2B sales experience  with strong outbound and cold-calling skills - ideally within a fast-paced transactional sales environment  Thrive in transactional sales  and can manage 300+ fast-cycle deals per month  Own the full sales cycle end to end  — from outbound prospecting and qualification to negotiation and closing  Are self-sufficient in pipeline generation , proactive in outbound activity, and confident converting warm leads from our strong inbound engine  Are comfortable selling to the US B2B market  and navigating a fragmented landscape of many smaller customers with frequent repeat purchases  Communicate clearly, negotiate confidently , and manage a large pipeline with discipline  Think entrepreneurial , act proactively, and stay organized and motivated while handling many fast-moving opportunities  Bring drive, resilience, and a success attitude  where every deal counts      What to Expect  Insights into perks, culture, and earning potential.  Uncapped Earning potential:  Our commission model rewards true hunters. With high transaction volumes and fast cycles, your results directly drive your income.  Ownership & impact at xChange:  You will have a direct stake in xChange as a shareholder with a competitive virtual equity package! You will also have full ownership and trust to drive impactful topics, supported by smart and driven individuals. Plus, get personal coaching and counseling ...  Entrepreneurial freedom:  You run your own pipeline, own your deals, and can make immediate impact from day one.  xChange culture & collaboration:  Our diverse and talented team operates with flat hierarchies and a growth-focused mindset which fosters an open-minded, collaborative, and high-performance driven culture where A-players thrive.  AI Focus:  We believe AI is a game-changer for sales success. At xChange, you’ll get hands-on experience with AI tools designed to streamline sales operations, enhance your skills, and boost your conversion rates. This is a unique opportunity to grow alongside AI technologies that will empower you to work smarter and close more deals.  Other perks at xChange:  36 off days for remote employees outside of Germany, mental healthcare & coaching program, language courses and many more. Feel free to ask the Talent team for details 😊  If this sounds like your future job, all we need is your CV which you can submit through the application link!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

We create the tools businesses need to make their business and their customer experience thrive!  As a key member of the Global Bank tribe, you’ll play a key part in helping us build SumUp's own digital bank. You’ll be part of a global, autonomous, cross‑functional team that takes an aspect of our product and perfects it from concept to execution. Becoming a part of the Global Bank Tribe means working alongside ~200 people of 32 nationalities across Cologne, Berlin, São Paulo, Santiago, Sofia, and Vilnius who love to take ownership, work with purpose, and help businesses thrive.  As a Senior Backend Engineer for our tribe, you will be responsible for evolving and maintaining the Brazilian side of the Transfers and Cards ecosystem inside SumUp Global Bank tribe, working within a highly‑available platform that operates with money transfers in various payment systems.  Please note that this position is hybrid in Florianópolis, SC - Brazil.  What You’ll Do   Evolve and maintain the Brazilian segment of the Transfers ecosystem within SumUp Global Bank tribe.  Supporting the transition from a localized setup with regional banks to a unified Global Bank.  Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services, while continuously evaluating and implementing new methods to ensure the high reliability of transfer systems.  Maintain and improve core services utilizing a modern, cloud‑native technology stack (AWS), with microservices (Docker, K8s) written in Go/Kotlin and Elixir.  Design, implement, and iteratively develop highly available backend services.  Improve test coverage for existing services and own the end‑to‑end delivery of changes, including testing, observability, and monitoring.  Continuously improve our engineering culture by refining best practices, clarifying problems and opportunities, prototyping solutions, providing comprehensive documentation, and selecting new tools and technologies.    You’ll be great for this role if   You are proficient in one or more modern backend languages, we use: Golang, Elixir, Kotlin, Java, Ruby, or one functional programming language.  You are experienced in developing and maintaining distributed microservices and RESTful APIs.  You have prior experience with modern cloud technologies (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).  You are knowledgeable in event streaming platforms and messaging brokers such as Kafka and RabbitMQ.  You have demonstrated an ability to learn new languages and technologies.  You feel comfortable working with SQL and NoSQL databases.  You have experience with CI/CD products such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD.  You take pride in your work, have a keen sense of ownership, and are dedicated to writing clear, maintainable, and testable code.  You’re a product‑focused engineer who is passionate and curious about solving user challenges.  Have great English communication skills - you'll be part of a truly global team!    Why you should join SumUp    Career Growth: Be part of a global team working on large‑scale fintech products used by millions of businesses.    Learning & Development: Access an annual budget of R$ 10,000 for education, certifications, and conferences.    Time Off: Enjoy 30 additional days off through our Break4Me program after 3 years at SumUp.    Grow with Us: Participate in our virtual stock program and benefit from SumUp’s success with company shares.    Global Experience: Collaborate with a diverse team of 3,000+ people from over 90 countries, and join our global off‑sites and hackathons.  🤝 Collaborative Culture: Join a team that values diversity, innovation, and teamwork, where your ideas and contributions truly matter.    Great Benefits: Health plans, meal vouchers (VR), Zenklub, Wellhub, life insurance, childcare allowance, and more.  Learn More About SumUp  🇧🇷 Office tour at São Paulo    Ask me anything: Engineering at SumUp  🚀 SumUp’s Innovation Hackathon  🤝 Get to know our hiring process  Job Application Tip  We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Software Engineer, Backend (All teams) – Brazil – Vaga para mulheres  Engineering the future of logistics – from Brazil to the world  This role is part of our commitment to increase the representation of women in technology at DoorDash Brazil. We strongly encourage candidates who identify as women to apply.  We are building an engineering team where women have equitable access to opportunity, leadership, and long-term career growth within our São Paulo hub.  At DoorDash, we believe diverse teams build better products. This opportunity is designed to create greater equity in access to engineering roles and long-term career growth within our São Paulo engineering hub.  DoorDash is building the world’s most reliable on-demand logistics platform. As part of our global expansion, we are investing heavily in Brazil and growing our engineering presence in São Paulo. This is a unique opportunity to join one of Silicon Valley’s fastest-growing companies—while staying close to home.  We’re looking for Backend Engineers who are excited to solve real-world problems at scale. You’ll work on product teams or platform teams that power our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Dashers, and Merchants . From improving restaurant discovery to optimizing delivery logistics, you’ll help shape the experience of millions of users.  You’ll work alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and designers—many based in the U.S.—so fluency in English and strong collaboration skills are essential.  What you’ll do   Design, build, and maintain large-scale backend systems used by millions of users  Contribute to our technical roadmap and define the architecture for key product areas  Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability, and security  Help transition parts of our monolithic codebase to a microservices architecture  Collaborate with cross-functional teams across Brazil and the U.S.  Work on high-impact features that directly improve the user experience for Dashers, Merchants, or Consumers    We’re excited about you because…   You have 1+ years of experience with backend technologies and distributed systems  You’re comfortable with modern web architecture (HTTP, REST APIs, grpc, microservices)  You’ve worked with relational and non-relational databases  You enjoy solving complex problems with elegant code and clear thinking  You’re fluent in English and confident participating in meetings and code reviews in English  You care about quality and write tests to ensure your code works as expected  You take ownership and enjoy working with autonomy in a fast-paced environment    Nice to haves   Experience working at a tech company with scale  Familiarity with Java, Kotlin, or similar JVM languages  Exposure to big data technologies or event-driven architecture  Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role    Why join DoorDash Brazil?   Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people  Be part of a fast-growing engineering hub in São Paulo  Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista  English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career  Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries  Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day  Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities    About DoorDash  At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.  DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We\'re committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.  Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.  This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace. E tem mais: inovamos nossos produtos e serviços para atender cada vez melhor nossos usuários! Por isso, hoje, contamos com soluções de entretenimento  (Claro música, Claro tv+, Claro livros, Claro vídeo e Claro gaming), finanças  (Claro pay) e muito mais! Temos presença aeroespacial  (com 5 satélites em órbita pela Embratel) e somos referência em conectividade industrial, automotiva, agronegócio  e outros. Também temos um ambiente de conexão entre nossos negócios e o ecossistema de inovação, que é o beOn , o hub de inovação da Claro e Embratel. Sustentabilidade  é um valor para a Claro. Investimos no desenvolvimento ambiental, economico e social, prezando sempre pela governança, responsabilidade ambiental, proteção de dados e impacto social. Por meio do Instituto Claro , conectamos pessoas para um futuro melhor, aliando os serviços prestados a investimentos sociais em projetos de educação e cidadania.  E aí, deu match? Gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado: Internet dedicada BLD e Responsável pela gestão completa dos produtos de Dados avançado , desde a concepção da ideia até o lançamento, performance financeira e estratégia de mercado. Garantir que os produtos estejam sempre atualizados, competitivos e aderentes à estratégia da Claro Empresas.  Pesquisa e Benchmark de Mercado  Monitorar tendências, concorrentes e novas tecnologias. Identificar oportunidades de novos produtos ou melhorias em soluções existentes, com foco em PMEs. Buscar e negociar com parceiros estratégicos. Avaliar viabilidade técnica, comercial e operacional das parcerias. Desenvolver business cases para novos produtos e iniciativas, validando viabilidade técnica, comercial e financeira.  Roadmap e Planejamento Estratégico  Definir visão, estratégia e roadmap dos produtos. Estabelecer metas de crescimento, penetração e receita para cada solução. Trabalhar em conjunto com Marketing, Vendas, Canais, Tecnologia, Jurídico e Atendimento para garantir o sucesso do produto. Garantir o alinhamento com as diretrizes da Claro e a jornada do cliente. Definir requisitos de produto em parceria com áreas de tecnologia, engenharia, marketing e atendimento.  Precificação e Modelo de Receita  Definir preços competitivos e políticas de desconto com base em benchmarks e estrutura de custo.  Go-to-Market e Lançamentos  Planejar e coordenar o lançamento de produtos: materiais, treinamentos, campanhas e argumentação comercial. Garantir a execução da estratégia de GTM (Go-to-Market), em conjunto com times comercial, canais e comunicação. Suportar os times de vendas com conteúdo e diferenciais do produto. Monitorar métricas de uso, receita, churn e NPS. Monitorar KPIs de performance, churn, receita, margem e adotar ações corretivas quando necessário. Propor ações corretivas ou de aceleração com base em dados e feedback dos clientes. Gerenciar o P&L dos produtos, atuando proativamente na rentabilidade e expansão do portfólio. Entender profundamente as dores e necessidades dos clientes (PMEs). Realizar entrevistas, pesquisas e testes de usabilidade. Fomentar a inovação contínua com foco na experiência do cliente, eficiência operacional e diferenciação de mercado. Influenciar stakeholders internos e externos, assegurando alinhamento e execução eficaz da estratégia do produto.  O que esperamos de você?  Perfil Comercial: garra para fazer acontecer, foco no resultado, perfil consultivo e escuta ativa do cliente; Empreendedorismo: visão de dono, sentir-se e colocar-se como conhecedor da sua carteira de clientes; Digital: antenado à tecnologia e inovação, facilidade para manusear a aprender a lidar com softwares e sistemas; Capacidade de Organização, Planejamento e Disciplina: senso de urgência, distribui bem suas tarefas e concluí-las ao longo do dia; Curiosidade: é inquieto! Quer aprender sempre mais, propõe novas soluções e questiona o status quo; Resiliência: capacidade de lidar com as adversidades e tornar as dificuldades aprendizados para futuras ações; Atitude, Ambição e Inconformismo: não se limita ao básico, quer algo mais e oferece além. Tem iniciativa para se antecipar a demanda e a necessidade do cliente; Relacionamento com Cliente/Empatia Digital: vê o cliente como sua prioridade, traduz a necessidade do cliente pensando na melhor solução para atendê-lo mantendo a visão de dono. Para fazer parte do nosso time, é essencial:  Graduação em Marketing, Administração, Engenharia, Economia, TI ou áreas correlatas Experiência sólida em gestão de produtos no setor de telecomunicações ou tecnologia. Vivência com P&L, GTM, desenho de produto e atuação em squads multidisciplinares. Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Produtos, Marketing ou áreas afins; Inglês e espanhol intermediário/avançado; Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas como Jira, Confluence; Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e extração de insights.  E por que a escolher a Claro?  Na Claro, pessoas é um dos nossos valores. Com este pensamento, investimos sempre no cuidado com a saúde, bem-estar e qualidade de vida dos nossos colaboradores! Para que você tenha a melhor experiência em sua jornada com a gente, oferecemos um atraente pacote de benefícios. Veja só: . Assistência Médica . Assistência Odontológica . Auxílio para patologias graves · Vale-Refeição e Alimentação · Auxílio ao Dependente com Deficiência · Previdência Privada . Seguro saúde - Pets . Wellhub · Convênios e Parcerias Na nossa empresa, valorizamos um ambiente inclusivo, diverso, ético, colaborativo e harmônico. Não fazemos distinção de gênero, raça, cor, orientação sexual, posição social ou deficiências. Todos e todas são bem-vindos(as)! Serving the world’s leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.  With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL’s evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.  Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ('MVNO') in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.  Position Overview  You will be part of an international team, driving the development of 1GLOBAL’s eSIM platform, including our consumer and IoT solutions. We are looking for a talented developer and team player, capable of handling architectural and technical specifications, designing and implementing new services, maintaining existing components, and testing our applications.  The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, Portugal; gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe’s most dynamic and renowned cities.  Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.  Key Responsibilities   Build high impact features and contribute to the architecture design; aim towards resiliency, scalability, security and fault tolerance.  Advocate for high code quality, readability and high tests coverage.  Promote best practices for a high-scale web (or mobile) environment.  Work with an Agile methodology.  Identify areas of improvement in the codebase and promote them through seamless integrations, documenting solutions and new flows.  Mentor junior members when needed and contribute with meaningful reviews.    Requirements   4+ years of experience in Java software development.  Experience with unit/integration/e2e testing (test-driven development is a plus).  Proficiency with REST APIs, both in implementing and consuming the interfaces.  Experience with development tools and processes (Git-flow, peer reviewing).  Familiarity with relational databases, CI/CD flows, Git, Docker, and Kubernetes.  Good understanding of cloud services and scalable infrastructure.  Excellent communication skills (fluent in English, both written and spoken), with a self-motivated and autonomous mindset.    Benefits   CLT contract  — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work.  Quarterly performance bonuses  to reward your hard work and achievements.  Meal allowance paid into Caju card —R$100 per working day.  Health insurance with SulAmérica —50% covered by the company.  Daycare allowance  provided to mothers with children under 3 years old—R$500 per month per child.  Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!    Why 1GLOBAL?   Growth Opportunities:  Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.  Major Transaction Exposure:  Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.  Work with a Talented Team:  From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals.  Dynamic Work Environment:  Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.  Professional Development:  Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.  International Experience:  Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.  Open Communication Culture:  Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.  Get Things Done Attitude:  Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.    1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.  Referrals increase your chances of interviewing at 1GLOBAL by 2x.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Full Stack Engineer em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About Revv  Revv is on a mission to revolutionize the global auto repair industry and shape the future of safer, smarter roads. Backed by $20 million in funding from visionary investors like Left Lane Capital, Soma Capital, Aglaé Ventures, and 1984 Ventures—and recognized as one of Bain Capital Ventures’ Top 50 Vertical SaaS Startups of 2024—we’re addressing the increasing complexity of modern vehicles and the ripple effect it’s having on repair shops. Our AI-powered platform is transforming how shops handle advanced vehicle safety systems, delivering actionable insights that streamline workflows, boost revenue, and enhance vehicle safety. With over 2,100 repair locations onboarded and seven figures in annual recurring revenue achieved in record time, we’re scaling rapidly—but this is only the beginning. At Revv, we’re not just changing the way repairs are done—we’re redefining the legacy of an industry that impacts millions of lives every day. Our bold vision is to become the global leader in auto repair technology, empowering shops of every size to master increasingly complex vehicles while ensuring safer roads for all. With our co-founders being named as Forbes 30 Under 30, support from industry leaders like Abhi Ramesh of Misfits Market, and an award-winning product celebrated for its innovation, Revv is setting a new standard for safety, efficiency, and growth. If you’re ready to join a team that’s shaping the future, rewriting the rules, and leaving a lasting legacy, we want to hear from you. Together, let’s revolutionize auto repair and build a smarter, safer world. Learn more about our journey here:  AlleyWatch About the Role  We’re hiring our first international Full Stack Engineer to take ownership of end-to-end product features, from database design to frontend components. This is a senior, backend-leaning role (roughly 70/30 backend/frontend) for engineers who thrive in fast-moving environments, write clean, maintainable code, and are ready to shape the technical foundation of our first engineering office in São Paulo. You’ll work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers to build scalable backend services, contribute to frontend features where needed, and establish technical best practices. Your work will directly impact thousands of repair shops and help scale a platform that’s redefining an entire industry. Responsibilities  Development  Design, build, and maintain backend services in Node.js/Express with TypeScript. Work with PostgreSQL for schema design, queries, and performance optimization. Implement APIs and integrations with external systems and internal services. Ensure backend systems are reliable, secure, and scalable. Build and maintain frontend components in TypeScript, using React/Next.js. Collaborate with design teams to translate wireframes and user flows into responsive, high-quality UI. Ensure robust, maintainable, and low-defect code. Write and maintain unit tests.  Collaboration & Delivery  Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback. Engage in architectural discussions and system design decisions. Work cross-functionally with PMs, designers, and non-technical stakeholders to align on priorities and timelines. Deliver high-quality features quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.  Leadership & Growth  Help define engineering standards (coding style, testing, CI/CD) for our international team. Serve as the anchor engineer for the São Paulo office, with potential to grow into mentorship or leadership as the team expands. Model best practices in communication, collaboration, and technical execution.  Qualifications  Must-Have  7+ years as a Full Stack Engineer, with strong backend focus (70/30 backend/frontend split preferred). Experience in SaaS development, ideally in B2B or infrastructure-heavy environments. Proficiency in Node.js/Express with TypeScript. Advanced PostgreSQL skills (schema design, queries, indexing, optimization). Track record of end-to-end project ownership (database to production). Experience writing and maintaining unit and integration tests. Active contributor to code reviews and improving team code quality. Proven ability to deliver high-quality results under tight deadlines. Strong collaboration skills with PMs, designers, and non-technical stakeholders. Written and spoken fluency in English.  Nice-to-Have  Frontend expertise in React/Next.js. Experience building integration test frameworks. Prior mentorship or leadership experience. Experience working in high-growth startups, navigating fast-moving environments, evolving priorities, and scaling engineering teams or products.  Why Join Revv?  Own end-to-end features that immediately impact customers. Shape the technical foundation of our first international office. Clear path into mentorship and engineering leadership. Work at the intersection of AI, automotive safety, and SaaS innovation. Collaborate with U.S. and international teams, gaining exposure to world-class SaaS practices.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nova oportunidade para Requirements Engineer for Cloud based Digital Emergency Services em guaíba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Overview  Requirements Engineer for Cloud based Digital Emergency Services – TK Elevator. This role is responsible for gathering, analyzing, and documenting the requirements for Digital Emergency Services features in cloud backend, embedded systems, CPaaS, security, and operations, ensuring that final deliverables meet regulatory requirements and business needs. You will work with a dynamic, global team to solve challenging problems and develop new digital solutions.  Responsibilities   Collaborate with product owners and field organizations to understand needs and translate them into clear, actionable requirements.  Translate regulatory and business requirements into detailed product features and specifications for development teams.  Create comprehensive requirement documents, including functional specifications, use cases, user stories, and acceptance criteria.  Support the development process with the product owner, including defining feature scope, tracking progress, and ensuring alignment with goals.  Maintain and update technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.  Develop test plans and test cases to validate solutions.    Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.  5+ years of experience in requirements engineering or a related role.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.  Experience with large, complex, highly scalable systems; preference for emergency systems, embedded systems, IoT, or similar solutions.  Knowledge of writing test cases and conducting manual testing (Unit, Integration, Functional).  Coding skills and experience with IoT and cloud applications are a plus.  Proficiency with requirement management tools (e.g., JIRA, Azure DevOps).  Experience with modeling techniques (e.g., UML, BPMN) is a plus.  Knowledge of agile software development methodologies.  Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.    What We Offer   Health care  Dental care  Bonus  Private pension  Program for pregnant women  Social support program  Life insurance  Telemedicine  Telenutrition  Telepsychology  Restaurant  Transportation    About TK Elevator  People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, we care about safety, and we share a vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility. title: Pessoa Especialista Product Owner
description:

Será responsável pela Squad de Experiência Digital,  com foco em proporcionar uma jornada fluida e personalizada nos canais digitais (Web). Atuará na construção e evolução do roadmap estratégico, garantindo a priorização de iniciativas alinhadas às principais métricas de performance do canal. Será o elo entre negócios, UX/UI e tecnologia, assegurando o entendimento claro das demandas do backlog e promovendo a colaboração entre os times para entregar soluções que realmente impactem a experiência do usuário. Responsabilidades e atribuições  Responsável por desenhar e evoluir o roadmap do produto com base nas principais oportunidades de geração de valor — tanto para o cliente quanto para o negócio. Essa construção será guiada por dados, insights e objetivos estratégicos, garantindo que cada iniciativa priorizada contribua diretamente para a experiência do usuário e os resultados da empresa. Responsável por estruturar as principais métricas que traduzem o sucesso dos produtos, garantindo que cada iniciativa esteja alinhada aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa. Atuará na mensuração contínua dos resultados, acompanhando os OKRs para assegurar que os esforços estejam gerando valor real para o cliente e impacto positivo para o negócio. Facilitar as principais cerimônias ágeis (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas) em parceria com o time de TI, promovendo alinhamento, colaboração e clareza sobre os requisitos de negócio e o progresso das iniciativas. Realizar testes em ambiente dedicado para validar se as funcionalidades desenvolvidas atendem aos requisitos definidos, garantindo qualidade e aderência às expectativas do negócio antes da implantação. Acompanhar e garantir a correta implantação de novas funcionalidades ou melhorias no ambiente de produção, assegurando que tudo funcione conforme o planejado. Também será responsável por alinhar com áreas parceiras sobre possíveis comunicações e divulgações de lançamento. Liderar a elaboração dos requisitos de negócio para novas funcionalidades ou melhorias, com base em pesquisas de mercado, benchmarking e alinhamento com áreas envolvidas. O objetivo é garantir entregas com alto valor agregado e foco na experiência do usuário.  Requisitos e qualificações  Habilidades e Competências:  Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica; Comunicação clara e eficaz; Liderança e gestão de equipes multidisciplinares; Organização, proatividade e foco em resultados; Foco em resultados e melhoria contínua.  Informações adicionais  Alelo Alimentação e Alelo Refeição; Benefícios de mobilidade para modelo de trabalho híbrido (Vale Transporte, Reembolso de fretado, Vale combustível e Pedágio); Alelo Cultura; Previdência Privada; Assistência Médica e Odontológica Bradesco Saúde; Gympass/Wellhub; Premiações com Pontos Livelo, além de descontos em nossos produtos; Incentivo Educação (pós-graduação, MBA e cursos de inglês) após 1 ano de empresa; Day Off para o colaborador no mês do aniversário e meio day off no aniversário do filho(a); Happy Friday (nas sextas-feiras saímos 1h mais cedo) e Summer Dreams (e nas sextas-feiras de verão, 4h mais cedo); Espaço massagem, manicure e barbearia; Cafés e frutas no escritório; Ambiente de trabalho criativo, desafiador e descontraído reconhecido como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pela GPTW 2024. Nova oportunidade para Especialista Java em joinville. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

O Desenvolvedor Especialista Java terá como missão contribuir para o desenvolvimento e a evolução de produtos estratégicos da TOTVS, como o TOTVS Java Framework (TJF) , Credential Helper , SmartLink Behaviour Sharing , TOTVS Privacidade de Dados (TPD)  e SmartTalk . Esses produtos atendem a clientes internos, como analistas, desenvolvedores, especialistas e engenheiros, e têm como objetivo facilitar integrações, garantir segurança, performance e escalabilidade, além de promover a conectividade entre plataformas e soluções da TOTVS. O profissional atuará em um ambiente dinâmico, utilizando metodologias ágeis (Scrum) e colaborando com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar soluções de alta qualidade que impactem positivamente nossos clientes e a eficiência dos processos internos. Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Especialista Java para integrar nossa equipe na TOTVS, com preferência de localização em Joinville ou Porto Alegre. A vaga é 100% remota, mas é necessário disponibilidade para comparecimento presencial em situações específicas, como reuniões de planejamento, encontros com clientes internos ou eventos de confraternização, como happy hours. Desenvolver funcionalidades e melhorias para os produtos da TOTVS, garantindo segurança, testes automatizados (unitários e end-to-end), documentação adequada e alto desempenho. Criar códigos que sigam os padrões internos de estilo, manutenção e práticas recomendadas para ambientes de alta escala, defendendo esses padrões por meio de revisões de código (code review). Participar ativamente de todas as cerimônias do Scrum, incluindo dailys, refinamentos técnicos, retrospectivas, planejamento de sprint e reviews. Resolver problemas técnicos de alta complexidade, propondo soluções inovadoras e eficazes. Colaborar com gerentes de produto, equipes de front-end, UX e outras partes interessadas para manter um ambiente interativo e acelerado. Identificar e propor melhorias em qualidade, segurança e desempenho dos produtos, reconhecendo impedimentos como "dívida técnica" e implementando soluções. Entregar melhorias com orientação mínima, colaborando em projetos maiores e fornecendo mentoria a engenheiros iniciantes e intermediários da equipe. Realizar webinars e criar apresentações objetivas e impactantes para demonstrar o valor das funcionalidades desenvolvidas. Contribuir com noções de marketing para divulgação e encantamento das entregas, promovendo engajamento com os clientes internos. Profundo conhecimento em desenvolvimento backend com Java e Spring Boot; Experiência em testes automatizados, fluxos de integração contínua (CI) e entrega contínua (CD). Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e metodologias ágeis. Familiaridade com tecnologias como GIT, Azure DevOps, Google Cloud Platform, RabbitMQ e conhecimento em oAuth. Conhecimento em ferramentas de monitoramento e comunicação, como Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, GoodData, Instatus e Slack. Já ter trabalhado com desenvolvimento de framework será um diferencial.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Advanced English (able to communicate with global teams and international stakeholders).  Strong strategic mindset combined with high execution capability. Background in scaling and transforming Customer Success teams.  Previous experience with marketplace products and high-volume B2C markets.    Additional Information   Working hours: Monday to Friday, from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.  Work model: Hybrid, with 2 days per week in the office for those who live in the Curitiba area. Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services. description:

Buscamos expandir nossa equipe com talentos que compartilham da nossa paixão por tecnologia e criatividade, e que queiram crescer conosco na exploração de novas fronteiras da comunicação digital.  Local de Trabalho: Presencial em Jundiaí, SP.  Objetivo da Função  Como AI Video Creator, você atuará na criação, edição e evolução de vídeos gerados com Inteligência Artificial. Seu trabalho combinará engenharia de prompts, o uso de ferramentas avançadas de IA para vídeo, imagem e voz, e técnicas de edição para entregar conteúdos realistas, bem finalizados e prontos para uso em campanhas, redes sociais e testes de performance da 2easy.  Perfil que Buscamos   Extremamente curioso sobre IA: Você está sempre explorando as últimas tendências e ferramentas.  Proativo e autodidata: Já testa ferramentas por conta própria e tem um portfólio de experimentos.  Ágil e adaptável: Gosta de aprender rápido, não tem medo de errar e itera com velocidade.  Detalhes e refinamento: Tem paciência para ajustes finos e um olhar crítico para o refinamento visual.    Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais   Inglês Avançado: Leitura, escrita e conversação fluentes são fundamentais para acompanhar as inovações e interagir com a comunidade global de IA.  Inteligência Artificial (Prática Obrigatória):  Engenharia de Prompts: Habilidade para criar e refinar prompts para obter os resultados desejados.  Prompts Avançados para Vídeo e Imagem: Conhecimento para ajustes de estilo, cenário, iluminação, ritmo e expressões.  Ferramentas de IA para Imagem: Experiência com ferramentas como Gemini, Midjourney, ou outras para a criação e variação de visuais.  Voz com IA: Experiência com clonagem e uso de voz com ElevenLabs ou similares, com foco em ajuste de entonação, pausas e naturalidade.  Capacidade de Teste e Evolução: Mais importante que dominar uma única ferramenta, é saber testar, comparar resultados e evoluir prompts.      Edição de Vídeo:  CapCut: Proficiência na ferramenta é essencial.  Edição com IA: Conhecimento de ferramentas de edição que utilizam IA.  Técnicas de Edição: Corte e montagem manual, sincronização de áudio, ajustes de ritmo e lipsync.        Desejáveis   Ferramentas de IA para Vídeo: Experiência com ferramentas emergentes como Veo, Sora, entre outras, é um grande diferencial.  Noções de Narrativa e Estética:  Enquadramento e ritmo narrativo.  Continuidade visual e acabamento para vídeo final.        Principais Responsabilidades   Criação de Vídeos com IA: A partir de vídeos base, áudios ou roteiros fornecidos pelo time.  Desenvolvimento e Teste de Prompts: Criar prompts avançados para variação de cenário, narrativa e diferentes versões de copy.  Edição e Finalização: Realizar cortes, sincronização de áudio, ajustes visuais e refinamento de lipsync.  Pesquisa e Inovação: Testar novas ferramentas e atualizações no campo da IA para vídeo.Documentação: Registrar aprendizados, melhores práticas, e o que funciona ou não.  Organização: Manter arquivos, versões e a biblioteca de conteúdos organizados.    Diferenciais   Já ter criado vídeos com avatares ou pessoas geradas por IA.  Noções básicas de design ou composição visual.    Se você é um entusiasta de IA com um olhar criativo e técnico, e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro do conteúdo em vídeo, queremos conhecer você!   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

MISSÃO DO CARGO  Garantir o crescimento sustentável da clínica, através da gestão estratégica do funil comercial, da liderança de equipe, da fidelização de pacientes e do desenvolvimento de parcerias externas , assegurando que cada experiência de atendimento reflita o padrão de excelência da Elite Clinic.  A gerente comercial deve unir visão analítica, empatia e foco em resultados , conduzindo o time e as ações comerciais com propósito e alta performance.  RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS  1. Gestão Comercial   Gerir o funil de vendas completo  (pré-agendamento → consulta → fechamento → pós-venda → fidelização).  Acompanhar diariamente os indicadores de performance : agendamentos, conversões, faturamento e upsell.  Criar e executar estratégias de recall e reativação de pacientes , principalmente nos períodos de menor fluxo.  Garantir o uso correto dos roteiros e processos comerciais padronizados  no Kommo e demais sistemas.  Validar todos os orçamentos antes do envio ao paciente e acompanhar o fechamento financeiro junto ao time comercial.    2. Gestão de Equipe   Liderar e desenvolver os times de Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente e Pós-venda .  Realizar reuniões semanais de alinhamento e resultado , com foco em metas e plano de ação.  Monitorar o desempenho individual, fornecendo feedbacks e treinamentos de melhoria contínua.   Incentivar a cultura de colaboração, comprometimento e entrega de resultados.     3. Parcerias Estratégicas   Desenvolver e gerenciar parcerias comerciais e institucionais  com empresas, academias, salões, influenciadores, laboratórios, e profissionais da área da saúde e estética.  Criar ações de co‑branding e indicação mútua , fortalecendo o posicionamento premium da marca.  Acompanhar os resultados de cada parceria  (número de leads gerados, conversões, faturamento e retorno de imagem).  Garantir que todas as parcerias estejam alinhadas à visão, valores e público‑alvo da Elite Clinic.   Apresentar relatórios mensais de performance de parcerias  à diretoria médica, com análise de ROI e plano de expansão.    4. Integração Estratégica   Trabalhar em conjunto com o marketing , acompanhando a performance das campanhas e qualidade dos leads.  Participar das definições de metas comerciais e campanhas sazonais  com a diretoria médica.  Garantir a integração entre recepção, enfermagem e equipe médica , evitando falhas na jornada do paciente.  Auxiliar na criação de campanhas internas e externas  para aumento de vendas e engajamento.    5. Pós‑venda e Fidelização   Supervisionar o acompanhamento pós‑consulta  e garantir a continuidade dos pacientes ativos.  Criar ações de fidelização e indicação  (NPS, Google Review, programas de vantagens, vouchers e experiências).  Mapear oportunidades de upsell e cross‑sell  para protocolos complementares (laser, estética, implantes, soroterapia, nutrição, etc.).    INDICADORES DE DESEMPENHO (KPIs)   Taxa de conversão de leads → mínimo 60%   Taxa de fechamento de protocolos → mínimo 40%   Faturamento mensal → meta definida pela diretoria   Taxa de reativação de pacientes → mínimo 30%   Satisfação do paciente (NPS) → mínimo 90%   Retorno sobre parcerias (ROI) → mínimo 3x     COMPETÊNCIAS ESSENCIAIS   Liderança inspiradora e foco em resultado  Comunicação clara e empática  Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica  Gestão de pessoas e negociação  Inteligência emocional e adaptabilidade  Networking e visão de negócios    REQUISITOS   Experiência anterior em gestão comercial de clínicas médicas, estética ou saúde premium.   Conhecimento em CRM (Kommo, RD Station, Pipedrive ou similares).  Habilidade com planilhas, metas e apresentações de resultado.  Vivência com gestão de parcerias, eventos e relacionamento B2B.     RELACIONAMENTO HIERÁRQUICO   Reporta‑se diretamente à:  Diretoria  Supervisiona:  Comercial 1, Comercial 2, Sucesso do Cliente, Pós‑venda e Recepção    OBJETIVO FINAL  Garantir o crescimento contínuo da Elite Clinic, fortalecendo a marca através de resultados comerciais sólidos, relacionamentos estratégicos e uma experiência memorável para o paciente.    #J-18808-Ljbffr

You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.  You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.  This role requires a balance of leadership and creativity in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment, where you’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.  Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.  Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines. Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team. Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.  Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.  Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.  Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.    You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You   3–6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people‑management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.  Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.  Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.  Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.  Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.  Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.  Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.  Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.  Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.  Bonus: Experience in e‑commerce or hospitality website design, familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.    Working at Darkroom  Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.  We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.   Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.  Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.  Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.    Equal Opportunity Statement  Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. description:

O Gerente Comercial é o profissional que atua dentro da empresa, atendendo o cliente, negociando interesses e coordenando o time responsável pela realização de um serviço. Ele será o responsável por organizar os recursos humanos e materiais disponíveis, alocando-os de acordo às necessidades, além de elaborar um cronograma de ações e disponibilizá-lo para todos os envolvidos no serviço. Principais responsabilidades:  Gestão, treinamento, capacitação e desenvolvimento do time. Parcerias para ações dentro e fora da unidade. Entrega das metas da unidade, assim como manter o funcionamento da unidade e de todos os seus processos dentro dos padrões exigidos pela franqueadora, conforme manuais e compliance. Principais competências:  Liderança, comunicação, persuação, proatividade, dinamismo, negociação, organização, planejamento, influência, visão estratégica, visão de mercado, ética, foco no cliente, expertise para vendas presencial e online. Atividades:  • Treina e desenvolve o time com as normas de atendimento padrões da empresa, garantindo e planejando um atendimento de excelência para os clientes; • Treina e desenvolve o time para alcance das metas da unidades; • Responsável pela gestão de pessoas e resultados da unidade; • Responsável por montar escalas mensais do time; • Gerencia e direciona atividades do time; • Atua na implantação e correção de procedimentos padrões; • Realiza avaliação de novos clientes; • Executa vendas e revendas dos pacotes de depilação a laser; • Presta atendimento e esclarece dúvidas de clientes; • Faz tratativa com cliente afim de evitar cancelamento de contrato; • Realiza desligamento de colaboradoras; • Fornece feedbacks e faz follow-up, visando corrigir comportamentos dos colaboradores dentro do ambiente de trabalho, além de melhorias em cada setor. • Extrai relatórios do sistema; • Responsável pelo bom funcionamento e manutenção e higiene da unidade; • Co-responsável pelo acompanhamento de todas as intercorrências e resultados desfavoráveis, prestando assistência e esclarecimentos ao cliente; • Desenvolve estudos sobre o potencial de vendas da região, realiza parcerias e prospecção de clientes para ações internas (unidade) e externas (rua), visando a ampliação do volume de negócios; • Apresenta estratégias e planos de ação para gerente de apoio/franqueado; • Reporta necessidade de manutenção na unidade; • Reporta informações sobre equipe e resultados para gerente de apoio/franqueado; • Monitora toda a documentação exigida pelos órgãos fiscalizadores e reportar para o escritório. Esse cargo não é pra você:   Se você não possui afinidade com a gestão de equipes de vendas, desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais, alcance de metas desafiadoras ou não segue o direcionamento aplicado por sua gestora, este cargo pode não ser o ideal.  A posição de Gerente Comercial requer uma liderança proativa, seguir diretrizes pré estabelecidas, habilidade em elaborar e implementar estratégias de vendas eficazes, além de habilidade para analisar resultados e ajustá-los conforme necessário.  Nosso objetivo é encontrar alguém que seja apaixonado por impulsionar resultados e liderar equipes rumo ao sucesso. description:

Zoetis values and supports inclusion, and is committed to equal opportunities.  Position Summary  Responsible for upholding the highest standards of ethical care and welfare for research subjects at the Zoetis Research Center in Paulínia, ensuring full compliance with all company policies as well as relevant local and international regulations and legislation concerning research practices. Additional responsibilities include supporting in vivo studies, training colleagues, and providing backup in related procedures. The role also involves establishing and monitoring key welfare and care metrics across the research operations.  Responsibilities   In collaboration with area management, develop and maintain a high-quality care program to promote health, wellbeing, and regulatory compliance for research activities at the Paulínia site. Focus areas include: disease prevention, biosafety, sanitation, pest control, management practices, safe handling protocols, responsible medication use and storage, and humane endpoints.  Perform daily rounds throughout the site to conduct veterinary inspections, ensuring optimal welfare conditions and that teams adhere to established procedures.  Maintain comprehensive records for research subjects to ensure traceability and documentation of medical history.  Guarantee ready access to controlled and non-controlled medications for research needs.  In collaboration with CEUA, expand and apply knowledge regarding local regulations and Zoetis internal standards to support accreditation and sustain best practice requirements.  Ensure complete alignment with Zoetis policies and the laws and guidelines of relevant authorities such as CONCEA, MAPA, CRMV, and others.  Actively participate in committee meetings and protocol reviews, sharing relevant updates and decisions with site teams in partnership with area leadership.  Report and communicate any events or concerns related to research subjects according to internal protocols and external regulations, updating the global team and implementing preventive measures as needed.  Provide technical expertise in veterinary science to support Zoetis and VMRD objectives, meeting client needs and contributing to collaborative scientific and service outcomes.  Apply scientific principles and practices to the development of tools and technologies that advance research models for drug discovery and development.  Collaborate with project teams to support research initiatives, including protocol and model development.  Foster communication between VMRD and GMS, serving as a role model for the broader Zoetis organization and presenting results internally and externally.  Train, educate, and guide colleagues in best practices regarding clinical procedures, research handling, care, and experiment-related workflows.  Identify opportunities for continuous improvement, emphasizing the principles of the 3Rs wherever possible.  Serve as the representative of the Paulínia site on the Zoetis Global Animal Welfare Committee.  As part of contingency planning, support in vivo research activities when needed.  Proactively prevent unsafe practices by following established safety guidelines and ensuring proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE).  Maintain strict confidentiality regarding sensitive information.    Requirements   Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Medicine, with an active CRMV license for at least 5 years.  Previous technical experience with the facility's working species – poultry and rodents – is desirable.  Solid experience in animal facilities or in the animal health products industry is preferred.  Advanced English proficiency.  A master's or PhD degree is desirable to provide additional technical support to the research team.  Planning and organizational skills.  Ability to work effectively in a team.  Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) principles.  Strong interpersonal skills to ensure positive relationships with colleagues from other departments.  In-depth knowledge of animal welfare and relevant regulations.  Activities are primarily concentrated at the animal facility located in Paulínia.  Work is preferably performed while standing, and requires moving between multiple buildings within the facility. Access to each building that houses different species must be performed according to established standard procedures, including changing clothes, showering, and other relevant protocols.  The employee must be willing to work weekends and outside of regular hours as required, according to on‑call schedules and veterinary occurrences.  The collaborator must also be available for activities outside the Paulínia site, such as meetings at Zoetis units in Campinas and/or São Paulo, visits to service providers and suppliers, as well as participation in events related to the field.    About Zoetis  At Zoetis, our purpose is to nurture the world and humankind by advancing care for animals. As a Fortune 500 company and the world leader in animal health, we discover, develop, manufacture and commercialize vaccines, medicines, diagnostics and other technologies for companion animals and livestock. We know our people drive our success. Our award‑winning culture, built around our Core Beliefs, focuses on our colleagues' careers, connection and support. We offer competitive healthcare and retirement savings benefits, along with an array of benefits, policies and programs to support employee well‑being in every sense, from health and financial wellness to family and lifestyle resources.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Solutions architect analyst
description:
Empresa está contratando Solutions architect analyst em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Join to apply for the Solutions architect analyst  role at Netvagas .  We are a global leader in the application and security industry. Our platform allows companies to operate with agility, reducing latency and increasing the reliability of their applications. We are focused on simplifying application building and looking for passionate and innovative individuals to join our team!  About The Position  As a Solutions Architect, you will be a specialist in Azion products, capable of translating and interpreting market trends and business challenges into scalable solutions. Acting as a Trusted Advisor, you will ensure best practices in the use of our platform and support the success journey of our clients. You will validate, test, and debug complex issues related to clients’ use of Azion systems, and research new technologies to deliver tailored solutions. As a Solutions Architect, you must be committed to scalability, performance, high availability, and security best practices, ensuring success across various industries such as Finance, E-commerce, Media, and Education.  You are highly technical, client-focused, and able to communicate complex concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally. You understand enterprise environments, argue from a technical perspective, and inspire confidence. You stay up to date with Azion’s platform and market innovations and most importantly, you take initiative and chase results.  Your Impact   Actively participate in the planning and structuring of integration projects;  Integrate client systems with Azion’s platform, guiding and configuring environments when necessary;  Be the go-to expert for Azion products and solutions;  Support Customer Growth teams in guiding clients through their success journey, including resolving questions and engaging with Product and Engineering teams;  Support Technical Support teams by acting as a platform expert;  Identify and propose improvements in both processes and products driven by customer demand or internal insights;  Research and propose effective solutions for complex and non-standard use cases (corner cases).    What You’ll Bring   Understanding (and eagerness to learn) about networks and how the Internet works;  Protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TLS, BGP;  Security solutions: Firewalls, WAFs, Bot Management, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, Paywall;  Configuration and use of proxies and reverse proxies;  Content Delivery Networks (CDN), including caching and edge caching;  Experience with troubleshooting techniques: connectivity, routing, protocol errors, web applications, application mapping, etc.;  Knowledge of web performance optimization: latency, throughput, load distribution, load balancing;  Experience with scripting languages (e.g., Python, BASH, JavaScript);  Proactive mindset for identifying and suggesting improvements;  Ability to handle multiple projects in an organized and collaborative way;  Ability to manage priorities, deadlines, and project delivery;  Willingness to stay updated with market technology trends;  Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Technology Management, or equivalent experience;  Intermediate English.    Bonus Points   Experience in consulting, technical training, or customer support;  Ability to analyze and define modern, distributed architectures;  Familiarity with distributed systems, microservices, and event/function-based integration;  Hands‑on experience with serverless and Function as a Service (FaaS) models, including Lambda Functions, Cloudlets, Workers, or similar technologies, with a focus on low latency, scalability, and orchestration;  Knowledge of streaming, distributed storage, high‑performance web servers, security, and cloud environments;  Advanced English and Spanish.    Benefits & Azion Way of Life   CLT hiring model;  Health and dental plan;  Flexible VR and VA (Flash Card), including during vacation periods;  Transport voucher without payroll deduction;  Annual internal hackathons;  Mobility allowance (additional amount for travel);  Freestyle (incentive to customize the workstation);  Stock options (according to policy);  Birthday day off;  TotalPass;  Flexible working hours (really flexible);  Nomad program to work from anywhere for up to 3 months a year;  Annual international exchange program.    FlexWork Model  We offer a FlexWork model that prioritizes acculturation and collaboration. For the first three months, you will work on‑site in the local office, an essential step in building solid relationships and a genuine connection with our values and culture. After this period, you will have the possibility to apply for the hybrid model, working on‑site at least three times a week. This approach balances interaction in person and autonomy, creating a dynamic and productive working environment.  Inclusivity Statement  At Azion, all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy, disability, ethnicity, color, country of origin, or religion. We believe that an inclusive environment contributes to our success and that respect is present in all our relationships.
